action.rationale: Fresh problem with small budget (100 < 20·dim = 200). Run limited probes (P1–P3) to read global structure and smoothness without overspending; evaluations are cheap and deterministic.

P2 shows strong global structure (fdc_spearman 0.7343) but with only 88 evals left (~8.8·dim) and no P3/P5 the local smoothness is unclear. A small race between turbo (model-based, sample-efficient at small budgets) and bobyqa (robust local) will quickly reveal which path improves from the incumbent y=1267.18.

Bobyqa won the race (1196.24 vs 1452.67) and is not exhausted (state.n_told=8), so it is early in its model-building phase. Probes show strong global structure (P2 fdc_spearman=0.7343) on a deterministic problem, favoring robust local refinement. With 72 evals left and dim=10, continuing bobyqa should efficiently reduce the incumbent (currently 1196.24 at eval 24).

Only 22 evaluations remain, bobyqa is still improving (improvement_in_tenure 136.2 over 50 evals; best 1060.06 at eval 78) and is not exhausted (stall_evals=2, exhausted=false). Continuing the current local solver is the safest refinement given no P5 data to justify switching to lbfgsb.
